messages:
sam_sales: Hey team — we need final alignment for the AcmeBank POC. They require EU data residency, want to run a 2-week eval, and have a security questionnaire due EOW. Main open: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private + acceptance criteria. Can we sync here?
lia_se: Quick context: use case = customer support summarization + redaction of PII. Expected peak qps ~15 req/s, avg tokens per call ~800, embedding batch jobs nightly. Data must stay in DE region. No external model export.
ben_sre: For residency + keys we recommend Dedicated in eu-central-1 or Private VPC if they insist on customer-managed KMS. Dedicated gives easier onboarding and lower cost than full Private. SLA asks? what are they expecting?
nina_ps: Customer asked for 99.9% uptime and 200ms p95 latency for short flows. For long summaries we can relax latency but they want 95th <1s. They'll run 2 canonical prompt sets for quality evals.
alex_prod: Proposed POC success criteria (draft): 1) Latency p95 <300ms for <=256-token responses, 2) Throughput sustain 12 qps for 30m, 3) Rouge/L match to baseline >=0.95 on eval prompts, 4) PII redaction recall >=99% on our redaction tests, 5) No data exfil in security scan. Thoughts?
sam_sales: Looks good. Pricing question from procurement: what's expected monthly cost delta between Hosted and Dedicated for this workload? Need a ballpark for TCO.
lia_se: Back-of-envelope: Hosted (eu) + 15 qps, 800 tokens avg => ~35M tokens/month. Hosted list pricing ~$0.02 per 1k tokens => $700/month token cost. Dedicated reserved capacity (small pool) estimated commit $7k–10k/month + infra. Private will be higher due to infra + ops. I'll confirm with finance.
ben_sre: Security checklist match: Dedicated supports customer SSO, audit logs, and can integrate with their KMS via approved connectors. Private gives full network control + on-prem if they want air-gapped. We'll need an SOC2 + ISO attestation copy — I'll attach in thread.
deploy-bot: Reminder: onboarding runbook for Dedicated in eu-central-1: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-onboard
nina_ps: On evals — please prepare 200 prompts covering failure modes and 20 adversarial PII cases. We'll run automatic grading and a manual spot check. Also include prompt templates and LR schedule.
alex_prod: For rollout policy during POC: use canary model variant (quantized 4-bit) with fallback to full-precision hosted model for rare heavy queries. Set throttles to avoid overcommit. I'll add config snippet:
```
routing:
  - policy: region_priority
  - fallback: hosted-full
  - canary_percent: 10
```
sam_sales: Action items: (1) ben - attach compliance docs & confirm KMS options by EOD Thurs, (2) lia - confirm cost numbers & Dedicated pool sizing, (3) alex - prepare routing + canary config and eval harness, (4) nina - assemble 200 prompt set. I'll loop in customer after we have numbers. :thumbsup: 
ben_sre: I'll upload SOC2 attestation and KMS connector notes. Also flag: if they require HSM-backed key storage on-prem, that's a Private discussion (higher lead time).
lia_se: FYI procurement also asked about termination / data retention policy post-POC. We'll need a simple export and deletion runbook.
sam_sales: Good call — include deletion proof (log) in acceptance. Also add success metric: proof of deletion for sample dataset within 30min of request.
alex_prod: I'll draft a short one-pager with deployment recommendation (Dedicated in eu-central-1 unless they require customer-managed KMS => Private). Will send by tomorrow.
sam_sales: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll send this summary to AcmeBank and ask them to sign off on criteria + hosting preference.
lia_se: No objections here. :white_check_mark:
nina_ps: +1
ben_sre: +1
deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder in 48h for procurement follow-up.
